_comment: What produced the predictions in this folder. Recorded explicitly because the mining model used to be encoded in the source directory name (results/ollama_gpt-oss-mcminer-latest_<arm>/) and that name is not preserved here.
note: These are judge INPUTS. run_dual_judge.sh does not re-mine them; it only re-scores them with the judges named in run_dual_judge.sh. Judging gpt-oss-mined predictions with gpt-oss-judge is self-evaluation; qwen36-judge is the independent one.
